chunks: My father, may Allah have mercy on him, narrated to us, saying: Sa'd ibn Abdullah narrated to us, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa, from Muhammad ibn Sinan, from Abu al-Jaroud Ziyad ibn al-Mundhir, from Abu Ja'far Muhammad ibn Ali al-Baqir (peace be upon them both)
Regarding the saying of Allah, Blessed and Exalted is He: 'Then flee to Allah. Indeed, I am to you from Him a clear warner.' He said: Perform pilgrimage to Allah.

key_terms.فَفِرُّوا إِلَى اللَّهِ: Flee to Allah (seek refuge/retreat to Him)

ai.seo_question: What does the command to 'flee to Allah' in Surah Adh-Dhariyat mean according to Imam al-Baqir?
ai.summary: In this exegetical report from *Mani al-Akhbar*, Imam al-Baqir (peace be upon him) offers a specific interpretation of the command 'flee to Allah' in Surah Adh-Dhariyat, identifying it with the ritual of Hajj. This reflects the Shia scholarly tradition of distinguishing between general Quranic injunctions and their specific, ritualistic applications as transmitted through the Imams, thereby linking spiritual retreat directly to the physical pilgrimage to the House of Allah.
